full_judgment: 2. Opposite party 2 Alauddin, opposite party 3 Moslemuddin and Abdul Latif (now dead) the husband of the pre-emptor and father of opposite party 2 jointly purchased on 13.12.48. 0.38 acres' land of plot 686 in SA khatian 322 and 0.33 acres land of plot 685 of SA khatian 240. The land under pre-emption is part of those lands. On 23.7.85 Alauddin opposite party 2 and Baser Pramanik @ Baseruddin Pramanik the preemptee opposite party1, both as transferors executed and registered a deed of exchange (Ext.1) showing transfer of 0.20 acres land (case land) by Alauddin, which he had inherited from his father said Abdul Latif, with 0.17 acres land of the opposite party 1 Baser Pramanik affixing the price of each piece of land at Taka 2000.00 only. The pre-emptor (opposite party 1 in the present revisional application) Golapjan, widow of said Abdul Latif and mother of opposite party 2 Alauddin filed the pre-emption case to pre-empt the said 0.02 acres land of Alauddin on the ground that the transfer was a sale and not exchange, said Baser Premanik is a stranger and she is a co-sharer and that no notice was served under section 89 of the said Act The pre-emptor further alleged that the transfer is a colourable one. In support of her contention she averred in the petition that on the same very day on 23.7.85 by deed 2524 Alauddin retransferred said.17 acres land of Baser Pramanik to him which Alauddin got by way of exchange from Baser by deed 2525. Pre-emptor brought another fact in her petition of pre-emption that on 23.7.85 by deed 2524 Baser Pramanik (opposite party 1) and Alauddin (opposite party 2) jointly purchased 0.01 acres land (each purchased 0.0 1/2 acres) from one Habibur Rahman which falls within the jurisdiction of Belkuchi Sub-Registry Office which is different from the Sub-Registry Office where the land under pre-emption and the land of Baser Pramanik do situate. This was done to facilitate registration of the fraudulent deed of exchange under a different Sub-Registry Office to suppress the fact of transfer of the case land from the pre-emptor. Both the transferors added. 0.0 1/2 acre land which each of them had purchased as aforesaid with their respective land while registering the deed of exchange purportedly on the same date. Both of the them again reconveyed the said 0.01 acres land to said Habibur Rahman by deed 2528 on the same date. From those facts and circumstances the pre-emptor made allegation that it is not exchange rather it is a sale and it is a colourable transfer which has been made with intention to defeat her right of pre-emption.
